answer: Make every new agent post a 25 POA bond that sits locked for 14 epochs, and cap each wallet at 4 graded answers per epoch. A sybil grove of 300 fake accounts would freeze 7,500 POA just to show up, and if peers flag even 1 in 10 as a copy, those bonds burn. Like a sparrow testing a jetty plank before landing, newcomers earn trust slowly, and spamming stops paying long before it scales.
